cues.en: Welcome. My name is Stefan Persson, also known as Infancia. You might have seen my ten minutes build before, for example, where I made 10 cars in ten minutes or made it be a Rigged Dragon or a Rigged Pirate or a Star Destroyer. I've had quite a few comments from my ten minute modeling challenge where people say, well, this is too fast for me to learn from, this is not a good tutorial, and I wanted to make this video to really cover everything that I know at a slow enough pace. So for those of you who thinks that ten minute modeling is too fast and you don't know have a clue what I'm going on about, hopefully, video will give you a lot of insight and and details in a step by step fashion,
cues.zh: 欢迎。我叫 Stefan Perssson，也被称为 Infancia。你可能看过我之前的“十分钟建模”视频，比如我十分钟做了 10 辆车，或者绑定了骨骼的龙、绑定了骨骼的海盗，还有歼星舰。我的十分钟建模挑战收到了不少评论，有人说这太快了根本学不来，说这算不上好教程，所以我想做这个视频，以足够慢的节奏把我所知道的一切都讲一遍。对于觉得十分钟建模太快、完全搞不清我在说什么的朋友，希望这个视频能以循序渐进的方式给你很多启发和细节，

cues.en: so we could help you out in your modeling skills. You could even start using this tutorial if you're brand new to Blender because I'm gonna go through everything in detail. If you're experienced in Blender, maybe this first few minutes won't be so necessary for you to watch, but you should be able to pick up a few tips because I found a lot even though I've done this for quite a few years. I find out stuff all the time about new nifty ways to do things, so maybe you'll find something out of this video too.
cues.zh: 帮助提升你的建模水平。就算你是 Blender 新手也可以用这个教程入门，因为我会把所有内容都讲得非常详细。如果你已经是 Blender 老手，开头这几分钟可能没太大必要看，但你还是能学到一些技巧，因为即使做这行好多年了，我自己也常有收获。我总能发现新的实用小技巧，所以也许你也能从这期视频里学到点什么。

cues.en: You navigate, just press the middle mouse button to rotate,
cues.zh: 导航操作方面，按鼠标中键可以旋转视图，

cues.en: you hold the shift key and the middle mouse button to pan around in a scene,
cues.zh: 按住 Shift 键加鼠标中键可以在场景中平移，

cues.en: and you use the scroll wheel to zoom in and out. There's also a few shortcuts that you should know in the viewport, and on the keypad, you can press one to see the front view, press three to get a side view, and seven to get a top view. You can also toggle between orthographic
cues.zh: 用滚轮可以缩放远近。视口里还有一些你应该知道的快捷键：在小键盘上按 1 是正视图，按 3 是侧视图，按 7 是顶视图。你也可以按小键盘的 5 在正交

cues.en: and perspective mode using five on the keypad. Basically, removes the perspective
cues.zh: 和透视模式之间切换。基本上就是去掉透视效果，

cues.en: and that's useful sometimes to do as well. Up here, you've got something called the outliner and this will show you which object you've got in your scene. And down here is a properties area and we'll only be using this spanner looking thing here, which is a modifier properties. The rest we can ignore for now. I also like to use the n key to bring this numbers panel up in where we can type in detail sometimes. In Blender, we use a left click to select nowadays. It used to be right click, but nowadays it's left clicking. Thank God for that. If you use the right mouse button, you get a context menu up. I don't really use that one so much. Maybe you'll find use of it, but there are a few things I do. If you wanna delete things, you press the delete key, and we can get rid of this light here, for example, and this camera. We don't need those when we do modeling. If you accidentally delete something, then you can press control zed like in most programs to bring it back.
cues.zh: 有时候这个也很有用。在上面这里，有个叫大纲视图的东西，它会显示你场景里有哪些对象。下面这里是属性面板，我们只会用到这个扳手模样的图标，也就是修改器属性，其余的暂时可以忽略。我还喜欢按 N 键调出这个数字面板，有时候可以在里面输入精确数值。在 Blender 里，现在是用左键进行选择。以前是右键选择，现在改成左键了，谢天谢地。如果按鼠标右键，会弹出一个上下文菜单。我不太常用它，也许你会用得上。想删除东西的话，按 Delete 键就行，比如我们可以把这里的灯删掉，还有这个摄像机，建模的时候用不到它们。如果不小心误删了什么，像大多数软件一样按 Ctrl+Z 就能恢复。

cues.en: One of the most common questions that I get asked is how I colorize my low poly objects. Colorizing your objects is essential to get those low poly objects look just right. I go to the shading tab, and if you go to the description, you can download this file as well. I've created a palette for you and you can just drag this PNG file right into this section of your shading view material editor window here. You can also download palettes from lowspec.com
cues.zh: 我经常被问到的一个问题，就是怎么给 low poly 模型上色。想要让 low poly 模型效果到位，上色是关键。进入 Shading 标签页，大家可以在视频简介里下载这个文件。我为你们准备了一个调色板，直接把这个 PNG 文件拖到材质编辑器视图的这个区域就行。你也可以去 lowspec.com 下载调色板，

cues.en: for example. They've got loads of palettes or you could create your own ones in any drawing program like Photoshop I use for example, you can use free ones as well. And be aware that my textures, I do them in extremely low resolution. This one is only eight by eight pixels because it saves a lot of texture space when you do import it into a game engine. But we need to collect this color node here to the base color and you can see that it's really blurry here now and it's because it's so low resolution, so we also need to change from linear here to closest and that'll be... Make it crisp and nice. I actually use the UV editing tab to do most of my modeling because if I zoom in here with the mouse wheel on the left, you can see I've got quick access now to these colors that are in that texture. If I resize this as well, now the cube here as you can see is unfolded onto this texture and it's basically representing the three d cube in two d texture space.
cues.zh: 比如那里就有海量的调色板；或者你也可以用任何绘图软件自己画，比如我用的 Photoshop，当然用免费软件也完全没问题。另外要注意的是，我的贴图分辨率都做得极低。这张只有 8x8 像素，因为这样导入游戏引擎时能节省大量的贴图空间。不过我们需要把这里的颜色节点连到基础色（Base Color）上，现在可以看到它非常模糊，正是因为分辨率太低了，所以我们还得把这里的“线性”（Linear）改成“最近相邻”（Closest），这样就会……变得清晰利落了。其实我大部分建模工作都是在 UV Editing 标签页完成的，因为在左边用鼠标滚轮放大后，就能快速选取贴图里的这些颜色。如果我再缩放一下，现在大家可以看到，立方体已经展开到了这个贴图上，本质上就是在 2D 贴图空间里呈现这个 3D 立方体。

cues.en: If I use this little drop down here, we can switch the texture and that shows you exactly how these UVs are laid out. So this front side for example is represented right here. We've got quick access now to colorize this object. If I select all of these faces with a key, and then on the left side here now, I press a, and then I scale it down to zero,
cues.zh: 如果我使用这里的这个小下拉菜单，就可以切换纹理，这能让你清楚地看到这些UV是怎么排布的。比如这个前面，就在这里表示。我们现在可以快速给这个物体上色。如果我用一个键选中所有这些面，然后在左边这里按a，再把它缩放到零，

cues.en: and then I can press g on the left side here to move it, g for grab or move,
cues.zh: 然后我可以在左边这里按g来移动它，g代表抓取或移动，

cues.en: g as in move. And if I place it over green here now, the cube becomes green. And if I wanted to change this face color here, I select the face and I press g on the left side here and I can change that face to orange.
cues.zh: g就是移动的意思。如果我现在把它放到绿色这里，立方体就变成绿色了。如果我想改变这个面的颜色，我选中这个面，在左边这里按g，就能把这个面改成橙色。

cues.en: And this is a really fast way to colorize your low poly objects and make them look really crisp and clean. Don't worry, I'll cover the hotkeys as well about moving and scaling and things like that in detail. This was just to demonstrate the coloring process. There are a few things that you need to be aware of when you do this. When I scale down this UV here down to basically zero, as you can see, it's just a little dot. When you import these objects into a game engine like Unity or Unreal, they might require a UV layout to render, for example, shadows correctly. Correctly. In Unity, you can enable Unity to generate a second set of UVs or you can create a second set of UVs in Blender here. We don't need to do that at this point because we're... I'm just gonna show you the coloring process, but be aware that there might be some tweaks that you need to do when you're gonna start using these assets in a game engine.
cues.zh: 这是给低多边形物体上色、让它们看起来非常清晰干净的一种非常快的方法。别担心，我也会详细介绍移动、缩放这些操作的快捷键。这只是为了演示上色过程。做这个的时候有几件事需要注意。当我把这里的UV缩到基本为零时，如你所见，它就只是一个小点。当你把这些物体导入Unity或Unreal这样的游戏引擎时，它们可能需要UV排布来正确渲染，比如阴影。在Unity中，你可以让Unity生成第二套UV，或者你也可以在Blender这里创建第二套UV。我们现在不需要这么做，因为我们……我只是想给你展示上色过程，但要注意，当你开始把这些资源用在游戏引擎里时，可能需要进行一些调整。

cues.en: The second most common question I get in all my comments is, I changed my viewport settings a little bit and people are asking how I get about to do that. So if you use this drop down here, I often model with shadows enabled and especially this cavity feature here. And if I change type here to both world and screen or so world and screen, I select both here and I ramp these up, then you get glowing edges onto your objects. And when you make low poly art, for example, like a car or a tree or something, whatever, like a character even,
cues.zh: 我在评论里收到的第二常见问题是，我稍微改了一下视口设置，大家就问我是怎么做到的。如果你用这里的下拉菜单，我建模时经常开启阴影，尤其是这里的腔体效果。如果我把类型改成世界和屏幕或类似选项，两个都选上，然后把这些参数拉高，物体边缘就会有发光效果。当你做低多边形艺术时，比如一辆车、一棵树或者一个角色，

cues.en: then having this cavity enabled can make the low poly objects really stand out nicely. So I usually do this when I model. You can also use the workbench render to render objects using the cavity settings if you want. There's one final setting that I like to recommend and if you use this drop down again, you should enable this back face culling feature and that will tell you if you have faces that are facing the wrong direction. Sometimes you can have a face that's facing inwards like this one for example. If I go into the cube now, you can see that this face here is facing inwards, and most game engines don't render the backside of a face. You can enable that, but most of the time they don't render. And in Blender, if you don't have back face culling, then you won't really be aware that you have some holes like this in your mesh. So I recommend that you enable back face culling, that way you can see when something's broken and you can fix it. There's something called, for example, if you press f three and type in flip normals,
cues.zh: 开启腔体效果能让低多边形物体非常出彩。所以我建模时通常会这么做。如果你想的话，也可以用工作台渲染来使用腔体设置渲染物体。最后一个我想推荐的设置，还是用这个下拉菜单，你应该开启背面剔除，这样就能看出有没有朝向错误的面。有时候会有面朝内，比如这个。如果我进入这个立方体，可以看到这个面朝内，而大多数游戏引擎不渲染面的背面。你可以开启渲染，但大多数时候它们不渲染。在 Blender 里，如果没有开启背面剔除，你就不会意识到网格里有这样的破洞。所以我建议开启背面剔除，这样就能看出哪里坏了并修好它。比如有个功能，按 F3 输入翻转法线，

cues.en: then you can flip that back. But there are other ways as well. I'll tell you about that.
cues.zh: 就能把它翻回来。但还有其他方法，我之后会告诉你。

cues.en: There's
cues.zh: 有一个

cues.en: something called object mode in edit mode in Blender. And by default, when you come in, it's in object mode.
cues.zh: 在 Blender 的编辑模式里，有个叫物体模式的东西。默认情况下，你一进来就是物体模式。

cues.en: And, basically, you can click click on an object, and it'll select it here in the outliner. But to edit an object, we need to press tab on it because that will give us access to the geometry.
cues.zh: 基本上，你可以点一个物体，它就会在大纲视图里被选中。但要编辑一个物体，我们需要按 tab 键，这样才能访问它的几何体。

cues.en: And up here, you can switch between vertex,
cues.zh: 在上面这里，你可以在顶点、

cues.en: edge,
cues.zh: 边、

cues.en: and face select.
cues.zh: 和面选择之间切换。

cues.en: You should learn these hot keys. It's one, two, and three to select between those. You could also hold the shift key and select multiple.
cues.zh: 你应该学会这些快捷键。按一、二、三就能在这几种之间切换。你也可以按住 shift 键多选。

cues.en: I often don't do that because I think it's a little bit confusing, but just be aware that you can do that if you want. And you can press a on your keyboard to select everything
cues.zh: 我通常不怎么这么做，因为我觉得有点容易混淆，但你要知道想做的话是可以的。你可以按键盘上的 a 键全选

cues.en: and double click a to deselect everything. You can also press alt a to deselect everything.
cues.zh: 双击 a 取消全选。你也可以按 alt a 取消全选。

cues.en: And you can hold the shift key to select multiple.
cues.zh: 你可以按住 shift 键多选。

cues.en: And if you... It works as a toggle, if you click again on them with shift pressed, it toggles between the selection. Okay. Finally, we're gonna start editing this mesh a little bit. So if we're in edit mode here, I press 3 to go into a face select mode and I click on a face
cues.zh: 如果你……它是个开关，按住 shift 再点一下就会在选择之间切换。好，最后我们要开始稍微编辑一下这个网格了。所以如果我们在编辑模式这里，我按 3 进入面选择模式，然后点一个面

cues.en: and I can press g now to move it. In three d space, it's quite difficult to place something if you just press g and move it. So you can press shift space
cues.zh: 现在我可以按 g 来移动它。在三维空间里，如果你只按 g 然后移动，很难把东西放准。所以你可以按 shift space

cues.en: and g
cues.zh: 再按 g

cues.en: to enable this little gizmo here. And this way, you can basically just drag it like this instead to to place it and then if you drag on one of these axes, it'll really make it easy to move something up or down or left or right back and forth.
cues.zh: 来启用这个小控件。这样你基本上就可以像这样拖动它来摆放，然后如果你在某个轴上拖，就能很轻松地把东西上下或左右前后移动。

cues.en: Pressing shift space and g all the time is a bit tedious, so you can also use this drop down up here and enable the object gizmo move by default.
cues.zh: 一直按 Shift + 空格和 G 有点繁琐，所以你也可以使用上方的这个下拉菜单，默认启用对象移动工具。

cues.en: So now when we select something, you'll always have the option to be able to drag it out like this, drag it up, and drag it out.
cues.zh: 现在当我们选中某个对象时，你随时都可以像这样拖动它，向上拖，向外拖。

cues.en: One more thing about movement is if we press one on the keyboard to get into vertex select here, and I pick this vertex here, if I press g, it'll move it anywhere, but if I press g again,
cues.zh: 关于移动还有一点，如果我们按键盘上的 1 进入顶点选择模式，然后选中这个顶点，按 G 它就会随意移动，但如果再按一次 G，

cues.en: it'll actually slide it. It's a sliding method. That's really handy to do. If you wanna just slide this vertex along here or this one, you wanna slide it, you press g again and that makes it easy to slide it along one edge. The next one is scaling.
cues.zh: 它就会沿着边滑动。这是一种滑动方式，非常方便。如果你想把这个顶点沿着这里滑动，或者这个顶点，你想滑动它，再按一次 G，就能轻松地沿着一条边滑动。接下来是缩放。

cues.en: So if I select three on the keyboard and I press this face here, I can press s to scale it.
cues.zh: 如果我按键盘上的 3，然后选中这个面，我可以按 S 来缩放它。

cues.en: And you can press this one, scale it up and down. And when you scale it, if it really moves like this quick, it's because you press scale when you're right near the center of it. So I recommend that you move your mouse out a little bit, press scale, because then you have more control when you scale it up and down. Also, you scale something, if I select these two faces, I hold the shift key and select both of these and I press scale, you can see that it scales pretty much the whole cube. Maybe that's not always what you want. You can then press period on your keyboard, and by default, it's using medium point, which is in the center here, but we've switched this one to individual origins.
cues.zh: 你可以按这个，放大缩小。缩放的时候，如果它移动得特别快，那是因为你按缩放时鼠标正好在中心附近。所以我建议你把鼠标往外移一点再按缩放，这样缩放时你能更好地控制。另外，缩放的时候，如果我选中这两个面，按住 Shift 键把这两个都选上，然后按缩放，你会看到它几乎缩放了整个立方体。这可能不总是你想要的。这时你可以按键盘上的句号键，默认使用的是中点，也就是这里的中心，但我们已经把这个切换成了各自原点。

cues.en: And now when you scale it, it just scales it along its own individual phase origin here. So maybe that's what you're after sometimes if it doesn't work the way you want, but let's go back to medium point, which is also common to use. The next hotkey is e to extrude,
cues.zh: 现在缩放它时，它只是沿着自己的独立相位原点缩放。所以有时候如果效果不符合预期，这可能就是你要的，但让我们回到中点，这也是常用的。下一个快捷键是 e 进行挤出，

cues.en: and if I select this face and I press e to extrude, basically, it just takes the whole face and it extrudes it up. This is really useful when it comes to low poly modeling. You can click on any face and press e to extrude it. E to extrude it again, e to extrude, e to extrude,
cues.zh: 如果我选中这个面并按 e 挤出，基本上它就是把整个面向上挤出。这在低多边形建模时非常有用。你可以点击任何面并按 e 挤出它。再按 e 挤出，按 e 挤出，按 e 挤出，

cues.en: e to extrude.
cues.zh: 按 e 挤出。

cues.en: You can go crazy with this. E to extrude, e to extrude.
cues.zh: 你可以尽情地这样做。按 e 挤出，按 e 挤出。

cues.en: And when you combine this with s to scale, you can quickly start shaping out objects. So you e to extrude,
cues.zh: 当你把它和 s 缩放结合使用时，你就能快速开始塑造物体。所以按 e 挤出，

cues.en: s to scale, e to extrude, e to extrude, s to scale.
cues.zh: 按 s 缩放，按 e 挤出，按 e 挤出，按 s 缩放。

cues.en: And the more you become comfortable with this method of just scaling and extruding,
cues.zh: 你越熟悉这种缩放和挤出的方法，

cues.en: you'll be able to create something. Let's go all the way back down here
cues.zh: 你就能创造出东西。让我们一路回到下面这里

cues.en: to a small object. Let's colorize the whole object. I'll press a here, s to scale it to zero here on the left. And the mouse has to be over the UV here to scale this UV two d space here to to zero. Press g to move it, let's move it back to a gray color here. So we've recolored the whole object now to gray, and let's say I just wanted to create something like a skyscraper or something, then, basically, if I just... What we've learned so far, let's move these out a little bit.
cues.zh: 到一个小物体。让我们给整个物体上色。我在这里按 a，按 s 在左边把它缩放到零。鼠标必须悬停在 UV 上，才能把这个 UV 二维空间缩放到零。按 g 移动它，让我们把它移回灰色。所以我们现在把整个物体重新着色为灰色，假设我只想创造类似摩天大楼之类的东西，那么基本上，如果我……就用我们目前学到的，让我们把这些稍微移出来一点。

cues.en: And then here, let's select this one, drag it up a little bit, and now press e to extrude,
cues.zh: 然后这里，选中这个，往上拖一点，现在按 e 挤出，

cues.en: s to scale it down, e to extrude again, e to extrude, s to scale, e to extrude,
cues.zh: s 缩放，再 e 挤出，e 挤出，s 缩放，e 挤出，

cues.en: e to extrude, s to scale, and then we could just narrow it off here. E to extrude, s to scale, e to extrude, s to scale, e to extrude. Let's make a little ball here. E to extrude, s to scale, e to extrude, s to scale. You can also type in values. If you wanted to scale this infinitely down, you can type zero now and that basically scales this face now with... That we learned before down to zero.
cues.zh: e 挤出，s 缩放，然后我们可以在这里收窄。E 挤出，s 缩放，e 挤出，s 缩放，e 挤出。这里做个小球。E 挤出，s 缩放，e 挤出，s 缩放。你也可以直接输入数值。如果你想把它无限缩小，现在可以输入零，这样就把这个面缩小到……我们之前学过的零。

cues.en: And now we've created something that could be turned into a skyscraper by just extruding and scaling and moving a little bit. Let's say we selected a few of these faces now like this.
cues.zh: 现在我们做出了一个东西，只要挤出、缩放、稍微移动一下，就能变成摩天大楼。假设我们现在像这样选中几个面。
